```{r Load required packages etc , warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}

## Load packages
library(tidyverse)


## Read in functions file
source("functions.R")


## Define auxillary variables
v_ICD_ACS = read.delim("../data/ICD10forACS.csv", sep=",") %>% dplyr::pull(ICD10) # ICD10 codes denoting ACS
v_MEL = c("DD050", "DD060", "XN120") #MEL codes denoting stent implant
v_ATC = c("B01AC04", "B01AC22", "B01AC24") # ATC codes denoting the drugs of interest
v_drugnames = c("clopidogrel", "prasugrel", "ticagrelor")


```

```{r Read in Data}

## Read in data
df_patients <- read.delim(file="../data/patients.csv", sep=",") %>% arrange(id)
df_hospitalstay_stent <- read.delim(file="../data/hospitalstay_stent.csv", sep=",") %>% arrange(id)
df_mel_stent <- read.delim(file="../data/mel_stent.csv", sep=",") %>% arrange(id)
df_hospitalstay_all <- read.delim(file="../data/hospitalstay_all.csv", sep=",") %>% arrange(id)
df_redemptions <- read.delim(file="../data/redemptions.csv", sep=",") %>% arrange(id)


## View heads()
head(df_patients)
head(df_hospitalstay_stent)
head(df_mel_stent)
head(df_hospitalstay_all)
head(df_redemptions)


## Save id columns as character vectors
df_patients$id <- as.character(df_patients$id)
df_hospitalstay_stent$id <- as.character(df_hospitalstay_stent$id)
df_mel_stent$id <- as.character(df_mel_stent$id)
df_hospitalstay_all$id <- as.character(df_hospitalstay_all$id)
df_redemptions$id <- as.character(df_redemptions$id)


## 125000 patients at this point

```

```{r Filter for IDs that have had at least one hospitalization related to ACS}

## Note: This initial filtering mainly aims to reduce data size


## Find hospital stays with ACS diagnosis (AI helped to check correctness of code)
df_hospitalstay_all <- df_hospitalstay_all %>%
  mutate(
    IsACS_hospitalstay = if_any(starts_with("diag"), function(x) x %in% v_ICD_ACS) # Comment-AI
  )


## Filter for ids with ACS diagnosis
v_ids_with_ACS <- df_hospitalstay_all %>% filter(IsACS_hospitalstay) %>% pull(id) %>% unique()
if(length(v_ids_with_ACS) > 0){
  df_patients <- df_patients %>% dplyr::filter(id %in% v_ids_with_ACS)
  df_hospitalstay_stent <- df_hospitalstay_stent %>% dplyr::filter(id %in% v_ids_with_ACS)
  df_mel_stent <- df_mel_stent %>% dplyr::filter(id %in% v_ids_with_ACS)
  df_hospitalstay_all <- df_hospitalstay_all %>% dplyr::filter(id %in% v_ids_with_ACS)
  df_redemptions <- df_redemptions %>% dplyr::filter(id %in% v_ids_with_ACS)
}


## Remove redundant objects
rm(list=c("v_ids_with_ACS"))


## 54743 patients remain

```

Note: df_mel_stent (originally "mel_stent.csv") and df_hospitalstay_stent (originally "hospitalstay_stent.csv") still have unequal number of rows. Find those ids with stent entries that are exclusive to only one dataset. It seems that the corresponding hospital stays are missing in df_hospitalstay_stent because they extend beyond 31st December 2024. Since this concerns just two ids out of thousands, I will remove them (see code below). Maybe these ids would anyway disappear anyway after assessing inclusion + exclusion criteria!

```{r Investigate incongruity of stent entries in df_hospitalstay_stent vs df_mel_stent and ultimately remove the corresponding ids}

## Add unique stent ID to both df_hospitalstay_stent and df_mel_stent
stopifnot(!any(is.na(df_hospitalstay_stent$stent_id)))
stopifnot(!any(is.na(df_mel_stent$stent_id)))
df_hospitalstay_stent$uniqueID <- paste0(df_hospitalstay_stent$id, "_", df_hospitalstay_stent$stent_id)
df_mel_stent$uniqueID <- paste0(df_mel_stent$id, "_", df_mel_stent$stent_id)


## Build intersection of unique stent IDs
v_uniqueID_intersect <- base::intersect(df_hospitalstay_stent$uniqueID, df_mel_stent$uniqueID)


## Filter for everything but the intersection (Comment-decision)
df_hospitalstay_stent_delta <- df_hospitalstay_stent %>% filter(!(uniqueID %in% v_uniqueID_intersect)) # 0 rows
df_mel_stent_delta <- df_mel_stent %>% filter(!(uniqueID %in% v_uniqueID_intersect)) # 2 rows -> 2 stent entries that are not in df_hospitalstay_stent


## Extract the ids that are missing. Explore the respective entries in both dataframes
delta_ids <- df_mel_stent_delta$id
df_hospitalstay_stent_delta_ids <- df_hospitalstay_stent %>% filter(id %in% delta_ids)
df_mel_stent_delta_ids <- df_mel_stent %>% filter(id %in% delta_ids)


## Remove the corresponding ids in all dataframes
if (length(delta_ids) > 0){
  df_patients <- df_patients %>% dplyr::filter(!(id %in% delta_ids))
  df_hospitalstay_stent <- df_hospitalstay_stent %>% dplyr::filter(!(id %in% delta_ids))
  df_mel_stent <- df_mel_stent %>% dplyr::filter(!(id %in% delta_ids))
  df_hospitalstay_all <- df_hospitalstay_all %>% dplyr::filter(!(id %in% delta_ids))
  df_redemptions <- df_redemptions %>% dplyr::filter(!(id %in% delta_ids))
}


## Remove redundant objects
remove(list=c("df_hospitalstay_stent_delta_ids", "df_mel_stent_delta_ids", "delta_ids", "df_mel_stent_delta", "v_uniqueID_intersect", "df_hospitalstay_stent_delta"))


## 54741 patients remain

```

```{r Merge df_hospitalstay_stent and df_mel_stent}

## First Check if df_hospitalstay_stent and df_mel_stent have the same unique stent ids
stopifnot(all(df_hospitalstay_stent$uniqueID == df_mel_stent$uniqueID))
head(df_hospitalstay_stent)
head(df_mel_stent)

df_stent <- cbind(df_hospitalstay_stent, df_mel_stent[,c("stent_date", "mel1", "mel2", "mel3", "mel4", "mel5", "mel6")])


## Remove now redundant dataframes
```

```{r Merge df_hspitalstay_all and df_stent to create df_hospitalstay_merged}

## Add stent_hospitalstay to df_stent
df_stent$IsStent_hospitalstay <- TRUE


## Replace diagnoses of "XXXX" with ""

  is.character(df_stent$diag2),
  is.character(df_stent$diag3)
)
df_stent$diag1 <- ifelse(df_stent$diag1 == "XXXX", yes="", no =df_stent$diag1)
df_stent$diag2 <- ifelse(df_stent$diag2 == "XXXX", yes="", no =df_stent$diag2)
df_stent$diag3 <- ifelse(df_stent$diag3 == "XXXX", yes="", no =df_stent$diag3)
stopifnot( # Comment-AI: Catch potential problems
  !any(df_stent$diag1 == "XXXX", na.rm = TRUE),
  !any(df_stent$diag2 == "XXXX", na.rm = TRUE),
  !any(df_stent$diag3 == "XXXX", na.rm = TRUE)
)


## Create unique hospitalstay ids in both df_hospitalstay_all and df_stent
stopifnot( # Comment-AI: Catch potential problems
  !any(is.na(df_hospitalstay_all$id)),
  !any(is.na(df_hospitalstay_all$cohosp_begin_date)),
  !any(is.na(df_hospitalstay_all$cohosp_end_date)),
  !any(is.na(df_stent$id)),
  !any(is.na(df_stent$stent_begin_date)),
  !any(is.na(df_stent$stent_end_date))
)
df_hospitalstay_all$id_beginDate_endDate <- paste0(df_hospitalstay_all$id, "_", 
                                                   df_hospitalstay_all$cohosp_begin_date,"_",
                                                   df_hospitalstay_all$cohosp_end_date, "_",
                                                   df_hospitalstay_all$diag1, "_",
                                                   df_hospitalstay_all$diag2, "_",
                                                   df_hospitalstay_all$diag3)
df_stent$id_beginDate_endDate <- paste0(df_stent$id, "_", 
                                        df_stent$stent_begin_date, "_",
                                        df_stent$stent_end_date, "_",
                                        df_stent$diag1, "_",
                                        df_stent$diag2, "_",
                                        df_stent$diag3)
stopifnot(
  length(df_hospitalstay_all$id_beginDate_endDate) ==

)


## check if larger data set (df_hospitalstay_all) contains the smaller one (df_stent)

## Do the merge
df_hospitalstay_merged <- merge(x=df_hospitalstay_all,

                                all.x = TRUE, by="id_beginDate_endDate") %>% arrange(as.numeric(id))
stopifnot(
  nrow(df_hospitalstay_merged) == nrow(df_hospitalstay_all)
)
df_hospitalstay_merged$IsStent_hospitalstay[is.na(df_hospitalstay_merged$IsStent_hospitalstay)] <- FALSE


## Check if merge was sucessfull
all(df_hospitalstay_merged[df_hospitalstay_merged$IsStent_hospitalstay,"diag1.x"] == df_hospitalstay_merged[df_hospitalstay_merged$IsStent_hospitalstay,"diag1.y"])
all(df_hospitalstay_merged[df_hospitalstay_merged$IsStent_hospitalstay,"diag2.x"] == df_hospitalstay_merged[df_hospitalstay_merged$IsStent_hospitalstay,"diag2.y"])
all(df_hospitalstay_merged[df_hospitalstay_merged$IsStent_hospitalstay,"diag3.x"] == df_hospitalstay_merged[df_hospitalstay_merged$IsStent_hospitalstay,"diag3.y"])
idx <- df_hospitalstay_merged$IsStent_hospitalstay

      df_hospitalstay_merged$diag1.y[idx] |

      df_hospitalstay_merged$diag2.y[idx] |

      is.na(df_hospitalstay_merged$diag2.y[idx])),

  all(df_hospitalstay_merged$diag3.x[idx] ==
      df_hospitalstay_merged$diag3.y[idx] |

)
```

```{r For each id, find Pooled index hospitalization periods within the allowed time window with both stent and ACS attributes}

## Note: Pooled Index Hospitalizations are defined as consecutive hospital stays no less than 30 days apart from each other within the following time period:
## On or after October 1st 2020 and discharged by December 31st 2022 (i.e., within "relevant hospitalization period")



## Initiate list for pooled index hospitalizations 
list_pooledIndexHosp <- list()


## Loop over each individual in df_patients and find all possible pooled index hospitalizations (as listed in df_hospital_merged)
for(i in 1:nrow(df_patients)){
  
  # get id of patient
  id_i = df_patients$id[i]
  
  # Calculate which hospital stays are within range of the "relevant hospitalization period" (hospitalization on or after October 1st 2020 and discharged by December 31st 2022)
  df_hospitalstay_merged_i <- df_hospitalstay_merged %>% filter(id == id_i)
  df_hospitalstay_merged_i$bool_afterStart <- df_hospitalstay_merged_i$beginDate_asDate >= as.Date("01.10.2020", format="%d.%m.%Y")
  df_hospitalstay_merged_i$bool_beforeEnd <- df_hospitalstay_merged_i$endDate_asDate <= as.Date("31.12.2022", format="%d.%m.%Y")
  
  # filter for all the hospital stays that are within the "relevant hospitalization period" (Inclusion criterion 2)
  df_hospitalstay_merged_i_filtered <- df_hospitalstay_merged_i %>% filter(bool_afterStart & bool_beforeEnd)
  if(nrow(df_hospitalstay_merged_i_filtered) == 0) next
  
  # calculate distance between subsequent hospital stays measured in days (Comment-studyteam: I got clarification on how a pooled index hospitalization can start by asking per email)
  stopifnot(all(order(df_hospitalstay_merged_i_filtered$beginDate_asDate) == seq_len(nrow(df_hospitalstay_merged_i_filtered)))) # Comment-AI
  df_hospitalstay_merged_i_filtered <- df_hospitalstay_merged_i_filtered %>% 
                                          mutate(
                                            days_until_next_stay = as.numeric(lead(beginDate_asDate) - endDate_asDate)
                                          )
  
  # Comment-AI: Define distinct pooled index hospitalization stays. AI checked the code and suggested coalesce() as a way to code more defensively
  df_hospitalstay_merged_i_filtered$indexHosp <- c(1,  # First stay is always contained within first pooled index hospitalizaion
                                                   1 + cumsum(coalesce(df_hospitalstay_merged_i_filtered$days_until_next_stay > 30, FALSE))[-nrow(df_hospitalstay_merged_i_filtered)]
                                                   )  # note:  Subsequent hospital stays always initiate a new index period i<-i+1 if the time between previous and current stay surpassed 30 days
  
  # Check if code works (Comment-AI)
  stopifnot(
  length(df_hospitalstay_merged_i_filtered$indexHosp) ==
    nrow(df_hospitalstay_merged_i_filtered)
  )
  
  # check which of these pooled index hospital stays contains at least one stent and at least one ACS 
  df_ifAny <- df_hospitalstay_merged_i_filtered %>%
                                  group_by(indexHosp) %>%
                                  summarise(
                                      any_stent = any(IsStent_hospitalstay),
                                      any_ACS = any(IsACS_hospitalstay)
                                  )
  v_indexHosp_keep <- df_ifAny %>% mutate(both_stent_and_ACS = (any_stent) & (any_ACS))  %>% 
                                   filter(both_stent_and_ACS) %>% 
                                   pull(indexHosp)
  
  # now filter for those pooled index hospital stays that meet the requirements of stent and ACS. Skip to next individual if length is 0
  df_hospitalstay_merged_i_filtered <- df_hospitalstay_merged_i_filtered %>% filter(indexHosp %in% v_indexHosp_keep)
  if(nrow(df_hospitalstay_merged_i_filtered) == 0) next
  
  
  # convert empty character entries "" to NA in the diagnosis columns
  df_hospitalstay_merged_i_filtered$diag1.x[df_hospitalstay_merged_i_filtered$diag1.x == ""] <- NA
  df_hospitalstay_merged_i_filtered$diag2.x[df_hospitalstay_merged_i_filtered$diag2.x == ""] <- NA
  df_hospitalstay_merged_i_filtered$diag3.x[df_hospitalstay_merged_i_filtered$diag3.x == ""] <- NA
  

  # add information on the number of relevant ICD10 comorbidity codes during each pooled index hospitalization (required as covariate adjustment later)
  df_indexHospStays_i <- df_hospitalstay_merged_i_filtered %>% 
  group_by(indexHosp) %>% 
  summarise(
    id = first(id),
    startDate = min(beginDate_asDate),
    endDate = max(endDate_asDate),
    number_com_ICD__hosp = {
      icd <- c_across(c(diag1.x, diag2.x, diag3.x))
      n_distinct(icd[icd %in% v_ICD_com], na.rm = TRUE) # Comment-AI: AI suggestion replacing the original for-loop I coded for step
    },
    days_in_hosp__hosp = {
      timediffs <- as.numeric(1 + endDate_asDate - beginDate_asDate)
      sum(timediffs, na.rm = TRUE)
    },
    .groups = "drop"
  )
  
  # save pooled index hospital stays (note: at this point one id may contribute multiple pooled index hospital stays with both stent and ACD attributes)
  list_pooledIndexHosp[[length(list_pooledIndexHosp) + 1]] <-  df_indexHospStays_i
}


## Convert list elements of pooled index hospital stays into a dataframe
df_pooledHosp <- do.call(args=list_pooledIndexHosp, what=rbind)


## Add all relevant columns from df_patients to df_pooledHosp
df_pooledHosp <- merge(x=df_pooledHosp, y=df_patients[,c("id", "sex", "birthDate_asDate", "deathDate_asDate")], all.x = TRUE, by="id") %>% arrange(as.numeric(id), startDate) 


## Add age in years at the start of pooled index hospitalization period. 
df_pooledHosp$age_in_years <- (as.numeric(df_pooledHosp$startDate - df_pooledHosp$birthDate_asDate)/365.25) %>% round(., digits=2)


## Add year of the start of the pooled index hospitalization
df_pooledHosp$year_of_start <- format(df_pooledHosp$startDate, "%Y") %>% as.character() %>% factor()


## Check number of distinct index hosp stays and ids
nrow(df_pooledHosp) # 25285 distinct index hospital stays across 24464 ids
df_pooledHosp$id %>% unique() %>% length()


## Save session (Stop_A)
fname <- paste0("Rsession_StopA", Sys.Date(), ".RData")
save.image(file = fname)
#load("Rsession_2026-01-12.RData")


## Remove some redundant objects
rm(list=c("df_hospitalstay_merged_i", "df_hospitalstay_merged_i_filtered",
          "df_ifAny", "df_indexHospStays_i", "list_pooledIndexHosp", "i", "id_i", "v_indexHosp_keep", "fname"))


```


```{r Filter out pooled index hospital stays based on remaining inclusion and exclusion criteria}

## Inclusion criterion 1: At least age 18 at the start of the pooled index hospitalization period -------------

# summary and filter
df_pooledHosp$age_in_years %>% summary()
df_pooledHosp <- df_pooledHosp %>% filter(age_in_years >= 18) # 25232 distinct pooled index hospital stays remain




## -------------------------------

## Inclusion criterion 5: redemption of a P2Y12 inhibitor between the start of the index hospitalization and 30 days after discharge (indicated by ATC codes in v_ATC)
## Exclusion criterion 3: redemption of one of the three P2Y12 inhibitors in the 12 months before the  start of the index hospitalization


## Create unique id for each entry in df_pooledHosp by concatenating id and indexHosp
df_pooledHosp$id_indexHosp <- paste0(df_pooledHosp$id, "_", df_pooledHosp$indexHosp)


## Initiate list that stores which of the P2Y12 inhibitors were used between start of index hosp and 30 days after discharge, as well as in the 12 month period up to the start of the pooled index hospitalization period
l_inhibitors_before <- setNames(vector("list", nrow(df_pooledHosp)), nm=df_pooledHosp$id_indexHosp)
l_inhibitors_after <- setNames(vector("list", nrow(df_pooledHosp)), nm=df_pooledHosp$id_indexHosp)


## Go over each unique id in df_pooledHosp and save the corresponding inhibitors redeemed 
for (i in df_pooledHosp$id_indexHosp){
  
  # extract row i
  df_pooledHosp_i <- df_pooledHosp %>% filter(id_indexHosp == i)
  stopifnot(nrow(df_pooledHosp_i) == 1)
  
  # extract id of row i, id_indexHosp, as well as start and end date of pooled index hospitalization 
  id_i <- df_pooledHosp_i$id
  start_i <- df_pooledHosp_i$startDate
  end_i <- df_pooledHosp_i$endDate
  
  # extract df_redemption_i
  df_redemptions_i <- df_redemptions %>% filter(id == id_i)
  
  # filter for redemptions before start
  v_ATC_i_before <- df_redemptions_i %>% 
                              filter(redemptionDate_asDate >= (start_i - 365.25),
                                     redemptionDate_asDate < start_i) %>% 
                              filter(ATC %in% v_ATC) %>% pull(ATC) %>% unique()
  if(length(v_ATC_i_before) > 0){l_inhibitors_before[[i]] <- v_ATC_i_before}
  # filter for redemptions after start until start + 30 days
  v_ATC_i_after <- df_redemptions_i %>% 
                              filter(redemptionDate_asDate >= (start_i),
                                     redemptionDate_asDate <= (end_i + 30)) %>% 
                              filter(ATC %in% v_ATC) %>% pull(ATC) %>% unique()
  if(length(v_ATC_i_after) > 0){l_inhibitors_after[[i]] <- v_ATC_i_after}
}



## Convert list output into dataframes that indicate which drug was used either before or after
stopifnot(all(df_pooledHosp$id_indexHosp %in% names(l_inhibitors_before)))
stopifnot(all(df_pooledHosp$id_indexHosp %in% names(l_inhibitors_after)))
df_before <- list_to_logical_df(l_inhibitors = l_inhibitors_before, v_ATC = v_ATC)
df_after <- list_to_logical_df(l_inhibitors = l_inhibitors_after, v_ATC = v_ATC)
stopifnot(identical(df_before$id_indexHosp, df_after$id_indexHosp) && identical(df_after$id_indexHosp, df_pooledHosp$id_indexHosp))


## Filter out those pooled index hospitalizations that meet exclusion criterion 3 (i.e., at least one of the three inhibitors was redeemed within 12 months before hospital start)
bool_kick <- df_before[,v_ATC] %>% as.matrix() %>% apply(., MARGIN=1, FUN=any)
v_ids_keep <- df_before[!bool_kick, "id_indexHosp"]
df_before <- df_before %>% filter(id_indexHosp %in% v_ids_keep)
df_after <- df_after %>% filter(id_indexHosp %in% v_ids_keep)
df_pooledHosp <- df_pooledHosp %>% filter(id_indexHosp %in% v_ids_keep)
stopifnot(identical(df_before$id_indexHosp, df_after$id_indexHosp) && identical(df_after$id_indexHosp, df_pooledHosp$id_indexHosp))
dim(df_pooledHosp) # 21478 pooled hospital stays remaining 


## Filter for those pooled index hospitalizations that meet inclusion criterion 5 (i.e., exactly one inhibitor was redeemed in the period between pooled index hospitalsray start and end + 30)
bool_any <- df_after[, v_ATC] %>% as.matrix() %>% apply(., MARGIN = 1, FUN=any)
sum_bool <- df_after[, v_ATC] %>% as.matrix() %>% apply(., MARGIN = 1, FUN=sum)
bool_keep_combined <- bool_any & (sum_bool==1) # Comment-decision: Kept those pooled index hospital stays with exactly 1 inhibitor used (i.e., not 2 or three)
v_ids_keep <- df_after[bool_keep_combined, "id_indexHosp"]
df_before <- df_before %>% filter(id_indexHosp %in% v_ids_keep)
df_after <- df_after %>% filter(id_indexHosp %in% v_ids_keep)
df_pooledHosp <- df_pooledHosp %>% filter(id_indexHosp %in% v_ids_keep)
stopifnot(identical(df_before$id_indexHosp, df_after$id_indexHosp) && identical(df_after$id_indexHosp, df_pooledHosp$id_indexHosp))
dim(df_pooledHosp) # 20598 pooled hospital stays remaining


## Now save which of the inhibitors was redeemed for each pooled index hospital stay
stopifnot(all(rowSums(df_after[, v_ATC]) == 1))
stopifnot(all(!is.na(df_after[, v_ATC])))
df_after$inhibitor <- df_after[,v_ATC, drop=FALSE] %>% as.matrix() %>% apply(., MARGIN=1, FUN=function(x){v_ATC[which(x)]})
df_pooledHosp$inhibitor <- df_after$inhibitor
stopifnot(all(df_pooledHosp$id_indexHosp == df_after$id_indexHosp))


## Save session
fname <- paste0("Rsession_StopB", Sys.Date(), ".RData")
save.image(file = fname)
#load("Rsession_2026-01-12.RData")
load("Rsession_StopB2026-01-12.RData")

## Remove redundant objects
rm(list=c("df_after", "df_before", "df_pooledHosp_i", "df_redemptions_i", "l_inhibitors_after", "l_inhibitors_before",
          "bool_any", "bool_keep_combined", "bool_kick","end_i", "fname", "i", "id_i", 
          "i", "start_i", "sum_bool", "v_ATC_i_after", "v_ATC_i_before", "v_ids_keep"))




## -------------------------------

## Exclusion criterion 1: Diagnosis of ACS in the 12 months before the index hospitalization (eligibility period)
## Exclusion criterion 2: Stent implantation in the 12 months before the index hospitalization (eligibility period)
## In addition: find total number of redeemed medications in eligibility period (Comment-decision: I will interpret the SAP here as "total unique medications". This variable will later be used as a covariate for adjustment)
## In addition: find date of subsequent ACS after end of index hospitalization


## initiate list
l_eligibility <- setNames(vector("list", nrow(df_pooledHosp)), nm=df_pooledHosp$id_indexHosp)

## Loop over each pooled index hospitalization and find which ids meet the exclusion criteria
for (i in df_pooledHosp$id_indexHosp){
  
  # extract row i
  df_pooledHosp_i <- df_pooledHosp %>% filter(id_indexHosp == i)
  
  # extract id of row i, id_indexHosp, as well as start and end date of pooled index hospitalization 
  id_i <- df_pooledHosp_i$id
  start_i <- df_pooledHosp_i$startDate
  end_i <- df_pooledHosp_i$endDate
  
  
  # extract all hospital stays for individual id_i
  df_hospitalstay_merged_i <- df_hospitalstay_merged %>% filter(id == id_i)
  stopifnot(nrow(df_hospitalstay_merged_i) >0) # must be true; else code above is bugged
  
  
  
  # filter for those hospital days with ACS after end of pooled index hospitalization + 30 days. Save date of first reccurence (NA if there is none)
  df_recurrent_ACS_i <- df_hospitalstay_merged_i %>% 
                                filter(beginDate_asDate > (end_i + 30),
                                       IsACS_hospitalstay)
  if(nrow(df_recurrent_ACS_i)==0){
    recurrentACSDate_asDate_i = as.Date(NA)} 
  else {
    recurrentACSDate_asDate_i = min(df_recurrent_ACS_i$beginDate_asDate)
  }
  
  
  # filter for those hospital stays within eligibility period
  df_hospitalstay_merged_i_filtered <- df_hospitalstay_merged_i %>%
                                          filter(endDate_asDate >= (start_i - 365), endDate_asDate < start_i)
  
  # check if there is any hospital stay in the eligibility period. Calculate relevant variables accordingly
  if (nrow(df_hospitalstay_merged_i_filtered) == 0){
    df_hospitalstay__eligibility_i <- data.frame(
                                          id_indexHosp = i,
                                          recurrent_ACSDate_asDate = recurrentACSDate_asDate_i,
                                          days_in_hosp__eligibility = 0,
                                          ACS__eligibility = 0,
                                          stent__eligibility = 0,
                                          number_com_ICD__eligibility = 0 # number of ICDs in the eligibility period 
                                      )
  } else{
    df_hospitalstay_merged_i_filtered$beginDate_asDate[df_hospitalstay_merged_i_filtered$beginDate_asDate < (start_i - 365)] <- (start_i - 365) # if any hospitalstay starts before the eligibility period, reset its start to begin of eligibility period
    df_hospitalstay__eligibility_i <- data.frame(
                                            id_indexHosp = i,
                                            recurrent_ACSDate_asDate = recurrentACSDate_asDate_i,
                                            days_in_hosp__eligibility = sum(as.numeric((df_hospitalstay_merged_i_filtered$endDate_asDate + 1) - (df_hospitalstay_merged_i_filtered$beginDate_asDate))),
                                            ACS__eligibility = df_hospitalstay_merged_i_filtered$IsACS_hospitalstay %>% any() %>% as.integer(),
                                            stent__eligibility = df_hospitalstay_merged_i_filtered$IsStent_hospitalstay %>% any() %>% as.integer(),
                                            number_com_ICD__eligibility = df_hospitalstay_merged_i_filtered %>% summarise(   
                                                                                     number_com_ICD__eligibility_i = {
                                                                                           icd <- c_across(c(diag1.x, diag2.x, diag3.x))
                                                                                           n_distinct(icd[icd %in% v_ICD_com], na.rm = TRUE) 
                                                                                     }) %>% pull(number_com_ICD__eligibility_i)
                                     )
    stopifnot(length(df_hospitalstay__eligibility_i$number_com_ICD__eligibility) == 1)
  }
  stopifnot(nrow(df_hospitalstay__eligibility_i) == 1)
  
  
  # extract all redemptions for individual di_i. Then filter for those redeptions within the eligibility period
  df_redemptions_i <- df_redemptions %>% filter(id == id_i)
  stopifnot(nrow(df_redemptions_i)>0) # must be true; else code above is bugged
  df_redemptions_i_filtered <- df_redemptions_i %>% 
                                      filter(redemptionDate_asDate >= (start_i - 365), redemptionDate_asDate < start_i)
  
  # check if there are any redemptions in the eligibility period. Calculate relevant variables accordingly
  if (nrow(df_redemptions_i_filtered)==0){
    df_redemptions__eligibility_i <- data.frame(
                                            total_redemptions__eligibility = 0,
                                            A10A = 0,
                                            A10B = 0,
                                            B01 = 0,
                                            R01 = 0,
                                            R03 = 0,
                                            C01 = 0,
                                            C02 = 0,
                                            C03 = 0,
                                            C07 = 0,
                                            C08 = 0,
                                            C09 = 0,
                                            C10 = 0
      
                                     )
    
  } else{
    df_redemptions__eligibility_i <- data.frame(
                                            total_redemptions__eligibility = df_redemptions_i_filtered$ATC %>% unique() %>% length(), # Comment-decision: I use unique() here which I think makes more sense. SAP not clear on that
                                            A10A = df_redemptions_i_filtered$ATC %>% grepl(x=., pattern="^A10A.*") %>% any() %>% as.integer(),
                                            A10B = df_redemptions_i_filtered$ATC %>% grepl(x=., pattern="^A10B.*") %>% any() %>% as.integer(),
                                            B01 = df_redemptions_i_filtered$ATC %>% grepl(x=., pattern="^B01.*") %>% any() %>% as.integer(),
                                            R01 = df_redemptions_i_filtered$ATC %>% grepl(x=., pattern="^R01.*") %>% any() %>% as.integer(),
                                            R03 = df_redemptions_i_filtered$ATC %>% grepl(x=., pattern="^R03.*") %>% any() %>% as.integer(),
                                            C01 = df_redemptions_i_filtered$ATC %>% grepl(x=., pattern="^C01.*") %>% any() %>% as.integer(),
                                            C02 = df_redemptions_i_filtered$ATC %>% grepl(x=., pattern="^C02.*") %>% any() %>% as.integer(),
                                            C03 = df_redemptions_i_filtered$ATC %>% grepl(x=., pattern="^C03.*") %>% any() %>% as.integer(),
                                            C07 = df_redemptions_i_filtered$ATC %>% grepl(x=., pattern="^C07.*") %>% any() %>% as.integer(),
                                            C08 = df_redemptions_i_filtered$ATC %>% grepl(x=., pattern="^C08.*") %>% any() %>% as.integer(),
                                            C09 = df_redemptions_i_filtered$ATC %>% grepl(x=., pattern="^C09.*") %>% any() %>% as.integer(),
                                            C10 = df_redemptions_i_filtered$ATC %>% grepl(x=., pattern="^C10.*") %>% any() %>% as.integer()
                                      )
  }
  l_eligibility[[i]] <- cbind(df_hospitalstay__eligibility_i, df_redemptions__eligibility_i)
}

## Convert list to dataframe. Then merge with df_pooledHosp
df_eligibility <- do.call(args=l_eligibility, what=rbind)
dim(df_eligibility) # 20598 pooled index hosp
stopifnot(all(df_eligibility$id_indexHosp == df_pooledHosp$id_indexHosp))
v_names_missing <- names(df_eligibility)[!(names(df_eligibility) %in% names(df_pooledHosp))]
df_pooledHosp <- cbind(df_pooledHosp, df_eligibility[,v_names_missing])


## Filter out ids that have stent in eligibility perid (Exclusion criterion 2)
df_pooledHosp <- df_pooledHosp %>% filter(stent__eligibility == 0)
dim(df_pooledHosp) # 20595 pooled index hosp remain


## Filter out ids with ACS during eligibility period (Ecxlusion criterion 1)
df_pooledHosp <- df_pooledHosp %>% filter(ACS__eligibility == 0)
dim(df_pooledHosp) # 20061 pooled index hosp remain


## Save session
fname <- paste0("Rsession_StopC", Sys.Date(), ".RData")
save.image(file = fname)
#load("Rsession_2026-01-12.RData")


## Remove redundant objects
rm(list=c("df_eligibility", "df_hospitalstay__eligibility_i", "df_hospitalstay_merged_i", "df_recurrent_ACS_i", "recurrentACSDate_asDate_i",
          "df_hospitalstay_merged_i_filtered", "df_pooledHosp_i", "df_redemptions__eligibility_i",
          "df_redemptions_i", "df_redemptions_i_filtered", "l_eligibility", "end_i",
          "fname", "i", "id_i", "start_i", "v_names_missing", "df_hospitalstay_merged_i"))







## -------------------------------

## Exclusion criterion 4: observation period shorter than 30 days after discharge of the index hospitalization (due to ACS, presumably)
## Exclusion criterion 5: death within 30 days after discharge of the index hospitalization


## Define time 0
df_pooledHosp$time_0 <- df_pooledHosp$endDate + 30


## Define date of potential administrative censoring (either at 3 years after time 0 or on 31st december 2024)
df_pooledHosp$potential_adminCensoringDate  <- pmin(df_pooledHosp$time_0 + 3*365.25, as.Date("2024-12-31"))


## Add event date to df_pooledHosp (minimum of death date, recurrent ACS date, or administrative censoring date either at the end of 3 years follow-up or on 31st december 2024)
df_pooledHosp$event_date <- pmin(
  df_pooledHosp$deathDate_asDate,
  df_pooledHosp$recurrent_ACSDate_asDate,
  df_pooledHosp$potential_adminCensoringDate,
  na.rm = TRUE
)


## Add last status indicator to df_pooledHosp
df_pooledHosp$Death_UntilAdminCensoring <- ifelse(test = !is.na(df_pooledHosp$deathDate_asDate)  &  (df_pooledHosp$deathDate_asDate <= df_pooledHosp$potential_adminCensoringDate), yes=1, no=0)
df_pooledHosp$ACSRecurrence_UntilAdminCensoring <- ifelse(test= !is.na(df_pooledHosp$recurrent_ACSDate_asDate) & (df_pooledHosp$recurrent_ACSDate_asDate <= df_pooledHosp$potential_adminCensoringDate), yes=1, no=0)
df_pooledHosp$last_status <- ifelse(test = df_pooledHosp$Death_UntilAdminCensoring | df_pooledHosp$ACSRecurrence_UntilAdminCensoring, yes=1, no=0)
check <- data.frame(time0 = df_pooledHosp$time_0,
                    deathDate = df_pooledHosp$deathDate_asDate,
                    recurrentACSDate = df_pooledHosp$recurrent_ACSDate_asDate,
                    admincensoringDate = df_pooledHosp$potential_adminCensoringDate,
                    event_date = df_pooledHosp$event_date,
                    last_status = df_pooledHosp$last_status)
stopifnot(all(!is.na(df_pooledHosp$event_date)))


## Calculate time until event (either death, recurrent ACS, or censoring). Timepoint 0 is defined as 30 days after end of pooled index hospitalization. Then filter accordingly
df_pooledHosp$time_to_event <- (df_pooledHosp$event_date - df_pooledHosp$time_0) %>% as.numeric()  # in days
hist(as.numeric(df_pooledHosp$time_to_event))
df_pooledHosp <- df_pooledHosp %>% filter(as.numeric(time_to_event) > 0) # Exclusion criteria 4 and 5
dim(df_pooledHosp) # 19745 pooled index hospitalizations remaining


## Remove redundant objects
rm(list=c("check"))


```
